contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 18
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 18 is executable and only global.css, Sidebar.css and Sidebar.test.tsx may change; JSX, Registry, navigation definitions, layout, Topbar, workspace content, backend, provider, data and runtime paths remain unchanged.

Remove the complete obsolete Sidebar-specific Legacy block from global.css including logo, section, heading, item, hover and active selectors so global.css contains exactly zero sidebar or sidebar-prefixed presentation selectors.
Preserve general global design tokens including text-secondary, surface-hover and accent and preserve platform-layout, platform-content, global box sizing and all unrelated global styles.
Do not replace removed Legacy rules with scoped duplicates, higher specificity, important, negative-margin, transform or offset workarounds.
Sidebar.css is the sole Platform Sidebar style authority and retains width 164px, min-width 164px, height 100vh and overflow hidden.
The canonical Section uses padding 6px 6px 0 and Heading uses 13px, weight 600 and margin 0 5px 3px.
The canonical Item uses width 100 percent, min-height 28px, flex display, centered alignment, 7px gap, padding 0 8px and 4px radius.
The canonical text uses 14px, flex 1 1 auto, min-width zero, nowrap, overflow hidden and text-overflow ellipsis while 12px Icons and optional 11px Chevron use flex 0 0 auto.
Canonical Sidebar hover and Purple selected states remain effective with white text and unobscured icons.

The combined cascade test evaluates Sidebar.css and global.css and detects artificial conflicts for logo, section, heading, item, hover and selected selectors across padding, typography, gap, height, min-height, radius, overflow, flex and state styling rather than only width.
Existing 164px width and legacy-width negative tests remain passing.
Tests obtain labels through getWorkspaceNavigation for all seven canonical Workspaces and do not use local replacement label lists as evidence.
Tests prove the required real labels originate from their canonical navigation sources and treat Incident Response separately as a Workspace display name rather than a NavigationItem label.

Tests render actual SidebarItem structure with its 12px Icon, text span and selected state and may use one controlled canonical-shaped child item only to exercise the currently unused optional 11px Chevron.

Width arithmetic derives positive bounded text regions of 117px without Chevron and 99px with Chevron from the effective canonical CSS values without claiming native browser font measurement from jsdom.
Only the text region owns nowrap, hidden overflow and ellipsis; SVGs cannot shrink and the complete item does not hide overflow that would clip icons, focus or selected state.
Rework 17 item geometry, Rework 16 WorkspaceSwitcher typography, Rework 15 grouping and naming, Rework 14 Sidebar Main separation and all earlier preservation gates remain passing.
Focused Sidebar tests, existing Topbar and WorkspaceSwitcher tests, real cross-workspace tests and PlatformLayout, SOC, Explainability and Executive regressions pass.
The full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass and Scope Guard confirms only the exact three authorized paths changed.
The immutable visual reference remains unchanged with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.
Product Owner Live Acceptance remains mandatory at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom across every real workspace Sidebar.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
